subject: CFG-1646: which environment drifted on a uniform key
body:
Hi, Daniel Ortega from the compliance team here. Please audit the ledger-api configs for drift: find the environment whose copy sets a must-be-uniform key differently from the rest, and name the key.

Keys that may legitimately vary (hosts, replicas, log levels) are listed in config/POLICY.md and do not count. Ignore the security keys for this question; they are a separate audit.

Thanks, Daniel Ortega
